name: Chicken with Roasted Cauliflower
subtitle: Whole roasted chicken with herb-scented cauliflower and crisp sourdough
description: A substantial roast dinner pairing tender chicken and browned cauliflower with garlicky thyme oil, stock, and toasted bread.

ingredients.item: sourdough bread torn into bite-sized pieces

instructions.text: Heat the oven for roasting. Stir the grated garlic and chopped lemon thyme into the 2 tablespoons of olive oil.

Set the chicken in a roasting pan and arrange the trimmed cauliflowers around it, keeping the leafy stalks. Crumble the stock cube into the chicken stock and pour it into the pan. Coat the chicken and cauliflower with the herb oil.
Roast until the chicken is cooked through and the cauliflower is well browned, about 60 minutes. Check the thickest part of the chicken with a thermometer; it must reach 165°F.
Add the torn sourdough pieces to the pan and drizzle with the remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Continue roasting until the bread is crisp and golden, about 20 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a board and return the pan to the oven if needed to deepen the bread's color, about 40 minutes total roasting time for the final stage.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes. Toss the toasted bread and cauliflower with the chopped parsley and remaining lemon thyme, then carve the chicken and serve with the pan juices.
